utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I really want to help, but do we know if they have the right parts for things like blenders? I'd hate to bring stuff they can't fix.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Good point about the parts. Have you had a chance to look at the error log though? I'd like to review it together to see what we're dealing with before anything else.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Let's check the error log, but I still want to confirm we have the correct spare parts for common issues like those blenders.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Leo, I heard about the repair drive. I've got a shed full of tools if you need anything for it.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, Gus. Bring them by Friday night so we can sort what's fixable.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Leo. I'll swing by Friday evening with my toolbox and that old drill I just fixed up.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, you should definitely come by! I heard they're also looking for people to help with the repairs, not just drop-offs.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh absolutely! It's this Saturday at 10 AM at the community center. Cleo's got the tools ready, and Oren's already got it on his fridge so he won't forget!

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great, I'm so glad everyone's on board! I'll bring some of those extra screws I found in my garage—they might come in handy.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I've been going through donations all morning, and Pia's right to ask about spare parts—maybe we should all meet up tomorrow to compare notes on what we've got versus what we actually need.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Tomorrow works for me. I can bring a list of what I have set aside.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, sounds like a plan. How does 10 AM at the community center work for everyone?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Bo! Have you heard about the repair drive we're organizing? We could use some help if you're handy.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh yeah, I think I saw something about that. I'm just planning to swing by on Saturday with my toaster, see if they can fix it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, I'll make a note of that! If you want, I can introduce you to the fixers when you come.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Rey, have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday? I'm thinking of bringing my wobbly chair.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, I've been trying to get the details straight. Do you know what time it starts?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard it's starting around 10 AM, but I'm not totally sure—maybe we can find out together?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Eli, I heard we're organizing a repair drive. Need any help coordinating or setting things up?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, Sam, we sure do! The repair drive kicks off at 9 AM sharp this Saturday. Could you help with setting up the workstations?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, I'll be there early Saturday to help set up the workstations. Just let me know where you want everything.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Faye, sorry I'm late—did I miss anything about the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: No worries, Dane. We're still figuring out details, but it looks like Saturday works best for everyone. Hana wants to check the error log before we start.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Ah right, Hana mentioned that error log earlier. Sounds like good planning—what's broken that needs fixing first?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Opal, that's perfect! Let's merge both drives and make it a big community event—I'll spread the word to everyone I've already talked to.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, I'll update my list with your crew and make sure Marcus's garage is ready for the extra supplies.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Awesome, I'll get the word out to Mara, Ira, and Uli right away—this is going to be a huge success!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Noah, are we fixing the community center roof or the playground? I keep hearing different things.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, I think it's the roof? Or maybe the playground... I always mix those up.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That's exactly my problem too! I was hoping you'd have the straight answer.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Mina! I'm so excited about the repair drive this Saturday—have you thought about what you might bring or need help with?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I'm planning to bring my power drill, but I'm still trying to pin down the exact start time—do you have that info?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes! We're kicking off at 9 AM sharp at my garage—Opal's got it listed as a collection point.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, Oren—are you sure I'm the one organizing this repair drive? I keep hearing different things.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, I thought you were involved! But you know me, I probably got it mixed up with someone else. I've got a flyer somewhere...

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: A flyer? Could you show me?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I think the start time is 9 AM — saw it on the flyer outside the grocery store this morning!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, that flyer might be outdated—the drive has actually been moved to Sunday at the community center. Are you still able to help?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Wait, Sunday? I didn't hear that—thanks for the heads up! I think I can still make it, what time does it start?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Oren, have you got the exact start time for the repair drive? I need to nail down the schedule.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the start time? I think I wrote it down... somewhere. Was it 9 AM or 10? Let me check my notes.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Well, which is it, Oren? I've got a full Saturday and I need to know if I'm starting at 9 or 10.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I hope they've got enough spare parts, Gus. I'd hate to drop off my blender only to find out they can't fix it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Don't worry, Pia, I've got a bunch of spare parts in my shed too. I'll make sure your blender gets fixed.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, that's a relief—do you know exactly what kind of parts they're low on? I could double-check my garage to see if I have anything useful.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Rosa, I've been rounding up tools and volunteers—got any idea how we should divvy up tasks for Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, Saturday? I thought the repair drive was tomorrow at 10—Vik told me it was for the community center roof. Are we doing the playground too?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Wait, no—the repair drive is Saturday, not tomorrow. Vik might've mixed it up. We're doing basic fixes at the community center, not the roof. The playground's separate.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Mara! Have you heard about the repair drive we're putting together? Got any broken gadgets or furniture that need a little TLC?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, Jules! I'm all set for Saturday—I've got my toolbox ready and I've been coordinating with a few neighbors to make sure we have enough hands.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That's great, Mara! Thanks for taking the lead on coordinating—let me know if you need me to reach out to anyone else.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Noah, are you helping with the repair drive too? I'm excited to pitch in—let me know what you need!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive—right! I think I've got a busted drill somewhere, but I keep forgetting to actually dig it out.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: No worries, Noah! If you find that drill, I can take a look at it—maybe we can get it working again.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh, the repair drive? I just got here, haven't heard much yet. Sounds cool though, count me in!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, Dane! We're meeting at Marcus's garage Saturday morning. Make sure to bring any broken tools or furniture you want fixed.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Saturday morning at Marcus's? Got it—I'll bring that busted chair of mine.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hey Rey, before we dive into the repair drive, did you get a look at the error log? I'd like to review it together.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, I skimmed it this morning. A few entries caught my eye—wanna go over them?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great, let's go through them now. I want to make sure we don't miss anything.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I hear you—busy day. I'm just gonna swing by with my toaster and see if they can fix it quick.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That's the spirit, Bo. I'm sure they'll have your toaster humming again in no time.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, hope so. You think you'll make it by?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So, Quinn, just to be crystal clear: you're confirming I'm one of the organizers for this drive, right? Because I've gotten mixed messages from a few people now.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, Kira—no mix-up at all! You're officially on the team, and we'd be lost without your spark at the playground this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Alright, Quinn, I trust you. But let me just double-check—is there a list or something so I know exactly what I'm supposed to be doing?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Uli, have you heard about the repair drive happening this Saturday? I'm thinking of checking it out.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, I'm planning to be there too. Bringing my old toolbox, figured it'd be good to have something to keep busy with.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, glad you're coming! Maybe you could take a look at my wobbly chair and broken toaster if you get a chance?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, Leo, it's this Saturday! I was just telling Cleo about it—she's got all the parts sorted and ready to go.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, glad Cleo's on top of parts. Got any broken tools to bring?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I think I have a few old screwdrivers that could use fixing. Do you have anything to bring?
